Bundled browser OCR assets (served locally by this site):

- tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0): tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js
  License text: LICENSE-tesseract-js.txt
- tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0): core/*
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/tesseract.js-core
  License text: LICENSE-tesseract-core.txt
- @tesseract.js-data/chi_sim 1.0.0 (MIT): lang/chi_sim.traineddata.gz
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tesseract.js-data/chi_sim
- @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (MIT): lang/eng.traineddata.gz
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tesseract.js-data/eng

Only the smaller 4.0.0_best_int language models and LSTM WebAssembly
variants are included. No OCR data is sent to a third-party API.
